channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Ancient Bedrock in the Southern Highlands
item.description: This image of an ancient rocky hill in the Southern Highlands proved to be surprisingly colorful due to diverse rock compositions. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
